users.title: Users
users.intro: Everyone with a login across the platform.
users.roleChangeFailed: Could not change role — this user has no tenant on record.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Edit pricing, included credits, caps, and rate limits for each plan.
plans.note: Changes apply to new subscriptions and the next renewal cycle.
plans.name: Name
plans.selectHint: Select a plan from the list to edit its pricing, credits, and limits.
plans.codeHint: Stable identifier (lowercase letters/digits/dashes) — cannot be changed later.
plans.codeInvalid: Code must be 2-31 characters of lowercase letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
plans.negativeInvalid: Price and credit values cannot be negative.
plans.confirmDelete: Delete plan “{name}” permanently? This cannot be undone.
plans.creditPolicyHint: Every brand-new signup automatically receives this many credits once, independent of any plan's monthly allowance.
plans.creditPolicyAmountHint: How many credits are added to a new customer's balance immediately after their first signup.
plans.creditPolicyInvalid: Credit amount must be a valid, non-negative number.
plans.numericHint: An empty or non-numeric value is stored as zero.

billing.title: Billing
billing.opsHint: Run period-end processing and dunning (normally scheduled).
billing.ordersEmpty: No orders yet. Checkout activates with the billing release.

usage.title: Usage monitoring
usage.intro: Platform-wide AI usage and credit consumption.
usage.empty: No usage recorded yet (needs live traffic through the gateway).
usage.rungHint: Rungs (L1–L4) are the model tier used per call; a lower rung is cheaper and faster.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: Drill into any tenant's search & assistant metrics.
analytics.zeroEmpty: No data for this tenant yet.
analytics.insightEmpty: Not enough data for an insight yet.
analytics.analystHint: Ask a plain-language question; the answer is grounded in this store's own metrics.
analytics.analystPlaceholder: e.g. Why did conversion drop last week?
analytics.analystEmpty: Ask a question to get a grounded answer.
analytics.degradedBanner: Elasticsearch is unavailable — search data (most wanted, zero results, funnel) is temporarily empty. The remaining figures come from the database.
analytics.analystDegraded: The analyst needs search data and Elasticsearch is unavailable.

models.title: AI models
models.intro: Every model imported from any provider — pick, edit cost/type, and manage in bulk.
models.pingHint: Any HTTP answer (even 404) means the service is up; a connection error means it is not running.
models.envConfigHint: Embeddings/reranker/local LLM stay environment-configured (owned infra, not per-call vendor billing). Paid vendors are managed below.
models.baseUrlHint: e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or your self-hosted vLLM endpoint.
models.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted server-side; only ever shown masked afterwards. Leave blank when editing to keep the current key.
models.isLocalHint: Marks this as the platform's own compute (never billed per-token to a vendor) — required as the last link of every routing chain.
models.templatesHint: Quick-add a known provider — just paste its API key.
models.discoverHint: Fetch this provider's real model list using its stored API key, then pick the ones you want.
models.maxRetriesHint: Retry this same endpoint this many times before moving on to the next provider/model (0 = no retry).
models.noProviders: No providers configured yet — add one to route paid model calls through it.
models.noModels: No models added to this provider yet.
models.modelName: Model id (as sent to the provider)
models.priceHint: USD per 1,000,000 tokens — from the provider's own price sheet.
models.rerankNotLive: Not yet wired into live search
models.pricingHint: How provider cost converts into tenant credits: platform margin over real token cost, plus flat prices for rungs that don't call a paid model.
models.usdPerCreditHint: e.g. 0.0001 means 10,000 credits = $1. Used to convert provider cost into credits charged.
models.marginPercentHint: Markup applied over the provider's real token cost before converting to credits.
models.searchCreditsHint: Flat credit price of a search-only turn (never calls a paid model).
models.localPriceHint: Optional cost attribution for owned/local compute (electricity, amortisation) — leave 0 to treat local calls as pure margin.
models.financeHint: What tenants consumed (credits, valued at the configured credit price) vs what the platform actually paid providers.
models.financeEmpty: No paid-model usage in this window yet.
models.bulkDeleteDesc: Delete {count} model(s) permanently? This cannot be undone.
models.bulkDeletePartial: {deleted} model(s) deleted; {blocked} blocked (in use by routing).

providersPage.title: AI providers
providersPage.description: Vendors the gateway can call — API key, priority, and full management for each.
providersPage.deleteConfirm: Delete provider "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

aiConfigPage.title: AI configuration
aiConfigPage.description: For each section, pick which provider and model to use — add extra failover models if you want automatic fallback.
aiConfigPage.globalFailoverDesc: Turning this off disables retry/switch-to-next-model everywhere — only the first model of each chain (plus the mandatory local model) is ever tried.
aiConfigPage.chatProviderFailoverHint: Each provider's "retry attempts" setting (on the Providers page) applies while this is on.
aiConfigPage.noBindings: No model configured for this section yet — the chain below is empty.
aiConfigPage.noEligibleProviders: No active provider with an API key is available.
aiConfigPage.noModelsForProvider: This provider has no models of this type.
aiConfigPage.issueProviderNoKey: This model's provider has no API key.

queue.title: Queue monitoring
queue.intro: Celery broker status and pending background work.
queue.hint: Worker-level inspection (active/scheduled) is added with the observability stack.
queue.noWorkers: No worker answered — start one: scripts/start-worker.ps1
queue.workersHint: Built from a live Celery ping; refreshes every 10 seconds.

health.title: System health
health.sparklineEmpty: Not enough samples yet — this page records one every 10 seconds.
health.sparklineHint: Each visit records a latency sample (the most recent 96 are kept).
health.deepHint: Every subsystem is probed concurrently: database, Redis, search, worker queue, the AI chain, and gateway/email configuration.
health.deepFailed: The health check could not run. Check the server connection.

security.title: Security monitoring
security.intro: Account lockouts, failed logins, and recent auth events.
security.unlockHint: Unlocking resets the failed-login counter so the user can sign in without waiting.

synonyms.title: Synonyms
synonyms.intro: Curate the per-tenant synonym set used by Persian search.
synonyms.helpBody: One rule per line. Comma-separated terms in a rule are treated as equivalent during search — e.g. a shopper searching "laptop" also matches products tagged "notebook" or "لپ‌تاپ".
synonyms.editorPlaceholder:
laptop, notebook, لپ‌تاپ
mobile, cellphone, موبایل
synonyms.exampleRules:
laptop, notebook, لپ‌تاپ
mobile, cellphone, موبایل
sneaker, trainer, کتانی

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Toggle platform capabilities without a deploy.
flags.effectAssistant: Shopping assistant (RAG chat) is available to stores; turning it off disables the widget chat tab and the chat APIs.
flags.effectInsight: The insight engine (demand gaps, funnel analysis) is computed and shown on dashboards.
flags.effectLeads: In-conversation lead capture (customer phone/email) is active.
flags.effectAgentActions: Money-moving agent actions (orders/payments/discounts) — off by default, only for fully hardened deployments.
flags.hint: Flag changes apply platform-wide immediately and are recorded in the audit log with the changer's name.
flags.empty: No feature flags are defined — flags are created by database migrations.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Append-only record of admin actions, auth events, and money tools.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.sec1: Admin access requires the platform-admin role (or the operator token for automation).
settings.sec2: All admin mutations are written to the append-only audit log.
settings.sec3: Sessions use short-lived access tokens with single-use rotating refresh tokens.
settings.sec4: Passwords are PBKDF2-hashed; failed logins trigger temporary lockout.
settings.securityHint: 2FA (TOTP) and IP allowlisting are on the security roadmap.
settings.platformBody: Vitrin — on-premise, multi-tenant AI Commerce Intelligence Platform. Plans, credit limits and AI-gateway budgets are configured via the control plane and the .env secret store.
settings.emailChanged: Email changed. Check your new inbox to verify it.
settings.operatorsBody: Add more admins or manage operator access — no bootstrap token required.
settings.totpBody: When enabled, signing in to the admin panel requires the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, …) in addition to the password.
settings.totpScanHint: Add this key to your authenticator app (add account → enter key manually), then enter the current code to confirm.
settings.totpEnabledNote: Two-factor auth is on — sign-in now requires the app code.

elasticsearch.title: Elasticsearch control
elasticsearch.intro: Inspect the cluster, manage catalogue indices, and run zero-downtime reindex + alias swaps.
elasticsearch.reindexHint: Build a fresh index from a source index, then swap the read alias (instant rollback).
elasticsearch.deleteConfirm: Delete index {index}? This cannot be undone.
elasticsearch.noIndices: No catalogue indices yet — create one.
elasticsearch.wizardHint: The three standard deployment steps: create the index behind the read alias, optionally reindex from a previous index, and atomically switch the alias. Each step drives the same console APIs and lands in the operation log.
elasticsearch.wizardStepEnsureHint: If the read alias doesn't exist yet, a fresh versioned index is created and attached.
elasticsearch.wizardStepReindexHint: Provide a source index to migrate data into a fresh index with zero downtime.
elasticsearch.wizardStepAliasHint: The read alias is atomically pointed at the final index.
elasticsearch.wizardSourceHint: Leave empty to only create the index and alias.
elasticsearch.wizardSkippedNoSource: No source index given — reindex not needed.
elasticsearch.wizardSkippedNoIndex: No index available to attach the alias to.
elasticsearch.logEmpty: No operations yet — wizard results and every action on this page are recorded here.
elasticsearch.logHint: This log is local to the session (most recent 100); the durable record of every operation lives in the audit log.

agent.title: Agent console
agent.intro: Pick a store and test the grounded assistant against that store's own indexed data.
agent.messagePlaceholder: e.g. آیا کفش نایکی سایز ۴۲ موجود است؟
agent.empty: Send a message to test the assistant.
agent.sessionHint: Each test uses a fresh session so it never mixes with a real shopper's conversation.

widget.title: Widget defaults
widget.intro: Platform-wide widget defaults. Stores can override branding from their own dashboard.
widget.previewHint: How the launcher looks with these defaults (a store can still override branding).
widget.livePreviewHint: The exact `widget/v1.js` file stores embed is loaded here in a sandboxed iframe, reading the saved platform defaults — the preview refreshes after every save.

contact.title: Contact inbox
contact.intro: Messages from the public contact form; click a message to read it in full, set its status, and keep a follow-up note.
contact.selectHint: Select a message from the list to see its details.
contact.noteHint: Visible to operators only; never sent to the sender.

operators.title: Operators
operators.intro: Manage platform admins — these accounts are fully separate from store users.
operators.note: Safety rails: no admin can suspend or delete their own account, and the last active admin can never be suspended or deleted. Suspension also revokes live sessions immediately.
operators.inviteHint: The account is active immediately; share the email and initial password so they can sign in and change it in Settings.
operators.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with upper/lower case letters and a digit.
operators.confirmSuspend: Suspend {email}? Their live sessions end immediately.
operators.confirmDelete: Delete {email} permanently? This cannot be undone.
